name: dictation-cleanup
description: Cleans your prompts before they are sent, typed or dictated: filler sounds, words that say nothing (basically, so yeah, I guess, a pause "like"), typos, spoken quotation marks, project names spelled as the project's docs spell them. A Haiku pass handles what only context can tell, and each of its changes is checked so it cannot reword you. Your message is drawn as Claude got it.
